batting.name: CH Gayle
batting.dismissal: c MK Pandey b AD Mathews

batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b R Sharma

batting.name: MJ Clarke
batting.dismissal: c SS Tiwary b R Vinay Kumar

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: st AB de Villiers b M Muralitharan

batting.name: AP Majumdar
batting.dismissal: c Z Khan b HV Patel

batting.name: AD Mathews
batting.dismissal: st AB de Villiers b KP Appanna

balls.text: shorter, slower and smacked over long-on for a six!
driven to mid-wicket for a single, bringing AB on strike

on his pads and driven to the deep square-leg fielder, the first one was easy, Tiwary wanted the second, de Villiers did not, and in the end, after a lot of misunderstanding they go for a second, easy run-out had he hit
outside the off stump, fuller from Thomas, he wanted to drive it away through the covers but mistimes it, driven to long-on for a single
pitched up to the bat, on his pads, opens himself up for room and drives it to long-on for a single
slower ball, waits for it and drills it back down the ground for a four! Splits the long-on and long-off field well
full-toss, driven to long-off for a single
pitched right up to the bat, driven to mid-on but the bowler was late in taking off to field that one, they come back for the second
slower one, tries to give himself room and pull, misses, hits his pads and they are off for a leg-bye
outside the off stump, driven to long-off for a single
short ball, was going back in his crease to pull it, but misses and Uthappa extends his hands vertically up to take that ball
down the track, pitched right up to the bat, drilled through the extra-cover region for a four!
gives himself room, drives to wide long-on and they are able to come back for a second.
full-toss, driven straight down the ground to long-on for a single
another one pitched right up to the bat, drilled to the wide long-on fielder, fielded well by Pandey, who then passes it on to Rahul Sharma
slower this time, outside the off stump and Tiwary has smacked it over long-on, flat six!
run-out! Pitched up, driven straight back to the bowler, Alfonso Thomas does well to field it, turn around and flicks the bails off, Dilshan was way out of his crease.
shorter, slower, Tiwary goes for a pull but he is way too early misses it by some light years.
dropped? outside the off stump, pitched up, probably deviating away, wanted to go for a drive, missed and dropped by Uthappa
down the track, it was a short ball and swings it over to deep mid-wicket but only a single
pitched up, driven to the off side, to extra-cover, where Smith fields for a single
slower one and pulled away, they get one, and come back for the second, the throw is a good one from Clarke but Uthappa takes some time to dislodge the bails
yorker length, middle stump, dug out and driven to the off side
outside the off stump, wanted to slog it away, hits the pads, loud appeal but given not-out
on his pads, flicked away to deep mid-wicket, it was a slower one and played well to get to his half-century
pitched up, driven uppishly to long-on for a single
shorter one, pull attempted, but the ball sneaks through between the bat and the stumps, misses the shot.
pitched right up to the batsman, drilled to the long-off for a single
outside the off stump, short of length, tries to force it through point but straight to the fielder
full toss, outside the off stump, driven but to the extra-cover fielder
outside the off stump, pushed to the point fielder and there is no run off it, that is 14 in this over and 30 in the last two.
down the pitch yet again, yorker length, driven to long-on for a single
down the track and gets an outside edge, goes to third-man for a four, three in a row!
four more, through the off side this time, on the off stump and that is almost a late cut to the pace bowler, the third-man was up in the circle
cheeky little paddle sweep from outside the off stump, through the fine-leg region, there was a short fine-leg in the circle but he wasn't chasing that one
short of length, outside the off stump, wanted to smash it hard, hits the bat high up and goes back to the left of the bowler, a difficult chance probably
full-toss, poor, poor ball, on the leg stump and Dilshan has pulled it away over fine-leg for a six, 16 off the over after he had conceded only 15 in his first three!
drilled straight down the ground, it was pitched up and he went for it, but to the fielder
shorter this time, quicker too, cut away but to the short third-man fielder
goes down the track and smokes it through extra-cover, Smith was diving at short cover but it was way beyond him!
shorter yet again, cut away once more but squarer and straight to the fielder
shorter ball, and this time the cut shot reaps benefits, placed through short third man and point and he gets a four
on the middle stump, not too much pace to work, pushed to the leg side for a single
down the track yet again and pushed to the off side, through the covers for a single
goes down the pitch but it is pitched right up, driven to the covers, four dots now
slower one, defended on the back foot to the off side, the bowler runs across to field the ball
outside the off stump punched to the off side, no timing yet again
on the middle stump, pitched up, pushed to the point region, but to the fielder and they decide against a single
flighted up to the bat, driven back to the bowler and that is the end of another excellent over.
down the leg side, quicker, tries to sweep but misses and it is a wide
on the middle stump, flicked it away to the leg side for a single
quicker, outside the off stump, spinning in and defended on the back foot
leading edge and caught at short cover! Skipper has caught his opposite number, was trying to  work him away to the leg side, gets an edge and it looped up to the fielder at short cover
full-toss, on the pads, could have gotten it away to the fence, instead it is straight to deep mid-wicket
shorter, bit of turn, opens the face of his bat, dabs it to the short third-man for a single
shorter, on his pads, flicked away to deep square-leg for a single
slower this time, defended on to the off side
shortens his length, drives to Smith at short covers
pitched up and driven through the extra-cover for a four
shorter, inside edge on to the pads
driven to short covers, was pitched up but cannot beat the field
short of length, pushed it again, punched to long-on for a single
on the off stump, a bit of turn, shorter too, tries to cut it, but does not get any power
pitched on the off stump, skidding on, cut away to the deep covers for a single
outside the off stump, slower, went for a drive but mistimes to short covers
pitched up, driven to short point, Smith fields well
on the middle stump, driven to the covers for a single
edged and gone for four through the slips, it was a quicker one, bounced much more and Dilshan rolled his wrists well, gets it through to fine third-man
outside the off stump, cuts it but straight to the fielder, Kohli wanted the single, Majumdar hits the stumps at non-striker's end direct
outside the off stump, punched to the sweeper fielder for a single
gives himself room, tries to smash it over long-on, but the ball did not come on to the bat and it is easily caught at the fence! Big, big relief!
on the middle, pitched up, driven to long-off for a single
outside the off stump, driven through the covers, to the right of deep cover and they are easily able to come back for the second
on the middle stump, rushing on quickly to Dilshan, that is played away to the off side for a single
shorter on the off stump, punched to the long-off fielder for a single
faster one, 92.8 km/hr, straighter and cut away to point for a single
outside the off=stump, quicker as well, spinning a little, skidded on and beats the bat
short ball, quicker too, rushing on to Gayle, tucked away to square-leg for a single.
short ball, tickled it round the corner and that beats the short fine-leg for a four! Delicately done!
outside the off stump, pitched right up to the bat, driven to point
on his pads, this time it is tucked away to deep square-leg for a single
short of length yet again, not pitching them in his half, Gayle takes the bottom hand off while defending it back to the bowler
short of length, but down the leg side, leaves it alone for the umpire to call it a wide.
slower one, on the stumps, Gayle blocks it to covers. He can defend too.
outside the off stump, pitched right up, drills it to third-man for a single
short of length, outside the off stump, wanted to cut it away, misses, the keeper was up to the stumps
and that is the fourth, almost an inevitable one, pitched up outside the off stump, and the Jamaican has bludgeoned it over long-off this time. The man is on fire. No really!
another one, third of the over, smacked over long-on yet again, and Gayle's making them pay for the run-out miss earlier. Three in four balls. Rahul Sharma's not even come on to to bowl.
another one, six over long-on, and this was expansive, pitched outside the off stump and Gayle gave his full extension of arms, it is gone many miles
short of length, on the off stump, cut away to the fielder at point
Ho ho! That is a six and one of the most effortless ones you would see on a cricket field, no back lift, does not move too much, just tees off over the bowler!
length ball, on the middle, pushed to mid-off for a single
yorker length ball, Gayle gets his bat down in time, edge on that one and its gone away to the third-man fence for a four
slower, on the middle and he waited for it, before smacking him over the bowler for a four!
short ball yet again and Dilshan went for a full-bloodied pull, there was a bit of a bobble from Majumdar, but only a single
full-toss down the leg side and missed by the batsman, called a wide.
short ball, probably a little quicker, Gayle was expecting it to rise over his head, almost ducked into it, before changing his stroke and pushing it to square leg for a single
slower bouncer, Dilshan was going down the track and then had to await its arrival, pulls it and by the time Clarke fields at short mid-wicket, they are away for a run
outside the off-stump, pitched up to the bat, driven strongly but to the mid-off fielder.
on the off stump, opens the face of the bat and guides it to the backward point fielder, decent start for Kumar
shorter and slower outside the off-stump, wanted to cut it but goes straight to the covers
was giving himself some room, almost moving down the track, wanted to blast it over mid-wicket, does not get the timing right, goes to Clarke, who shies at the non-striker's end, misses
short ball, pulled away by Dilshan, goes straight to the deep square-leg fielder and all they get is a single
pitched up, on the off stump, wanted to drive it but the timing goes awry, back to the bowler
short ball, it was quicker as well, went for the pull, hits the batsman on his back leg, high, and goes to the third-man fielder, good running gives them two
pitched on middle and going down the leg side, Dilshan did try to flick it away but misses
gone, six! That is a big six, pitched up, within the stumps and lofted over long-on, it went into the crowds. Gayle's in town!
pitched up, driven to mid-on for a single, the fielder throws it at the non-striker's end again, and misses.
opens the face of the bat, guides it to the point region, goes for a quick single there
goes down the pitch, wants to slam it over the bowler, misses getting it in the middle of the bat
short ball outside the off stump and Gayle wanted to smack it down the wicket, straight to the fielder
outside the off-stump and boom, smacked over extra-cover! It was pitched up and there was a bit of width too!

goes down the the pitch, drives to mid-on and sets off for a single, the throw came in quickly from mid-on and for the second time in two overs, had it hit the non-striker's stumps, it would have been out.
outside the off stump, short of good length and that is left alone by the batsman
good length, within the stumps, punched down the ground to the left of mid-off, good stop.
pitched up and hits the pads, loud appeal for an lbw, but the umpire gives it not-out equally vehemently!
outside the off stump, punched to the covers
smashed through wide mid-off for a four, pitched up and slight swing away, it was a Free Hit and Dilshan was taking no prisoners there.
on the leg stump, nudged to mid-on and they are off for a single, good delivery to a batsman like Gayle but he over-steps!
outside the off stump, again not pitched up, opens the face of the bat and guides him to third-man for a single
short of length, punched to the leg side for a single

pitched up, outside the off stump, swung in and Gayle had to adjust his drive, inside edge to the left of the bowler, who ran to get there and tried to throw down the stumps at the striker's end, had it hit, Dilshan would have been a goner!
outside the off stump, short of length, cut hard but well fielded at point by Smith, it was going straight to him but rather rapidly
defended on the front foot, towards mid-off and the score remains at zero
outside the off stump, pitched full, left it alone by Gayle and through to the keeper
pitched right up and driven to extra-cover for a single, that is a facile win for Bangalore
slower, shorter and forehanded back through the bowler for a couple of runs
shorter run-up, slower, gets an outside edge to third-man
from over the wicket this time, outside the off stump, wanted to go for another heave, misses
again from round the stumps, outside the off stump, wanted to pull it away, short of length, missed
slower one and it is swung away across the line, sails over deep mid-wicket for a six!
pitched right up yet again, he is doing this well, driven to long-on for a single
pitched right up to the bat, wanted to heave it away, gets an outside edge over the covers for a single
short from Zaheer, almost takes the batsman by surprise, last minute decision to pull, hits the toe end of the bat and it goes to mid-off for a single
pitched right up to the bat from round the stumps, digs out well, but back to the bowler
pitched up to his pads, half volley, clipped away in the air to the deep square-leg fielder for a couple
full-toss from round the wicket, punched to deep mid-wicket but there is a fielder there
length ball, goes for a pull and misses the bat, but not stumps! Kumar celebrates with a jig and Pune have lost their ninth. The end isn't too far.
yorker length, it was a very slow ball, Smith had his bat up in an attempt to smash it away but had to dig it out in the end.
slower one, wanted to slog it away, mistimes to long-on and Kohli misfields yet again, allowing the batsmen to come back for the second
short of length ball, outside the leg stump, wanted to flick it, hits his pad and they are off for a leg-bye
from round the wicket, yorker, goes through the defences and the middle stump is flattened. Eight down now
full-toss, drilled down the ground to long-on for a single
up and over the short cover fielder, Thomas gave himself room and blasted it over the short cover fielder, not too much chance for the fielders in deep
outside the off stump, full-toss and the batsman is unable to punch it back to the bowler
on his pads, pitched right up to the bat, he was moving around in his crease, misses getting any bat to it
opens the face of the bat again, taps to off side for a single
short of length, opens the face of the bat, played it to third-man for a single
outside the off stump, slower, opens the face of the bat and guides it to third-man for a single
short of length, bit of spin, nudged to the leg side for a run to Thomas
quicker from outside the off stump, spinning into the batsman, he goes on to the back foot, kept low and that has castled him!
outside the off stump, not turning too much, played away to point
quicker one, goes through, tries to flick it, gets an inside edge to the leg side
goes down the track and can only chip it away to mid-wicket for a single
on the middle stump, quicker from him, swept away to long-leg for a single
a very slow slower ball, less than 110 km/hr, did not rise up too much either, wanted to go over extra-cover but misses, goes on a couple of bounces to the keeper
slower again, pitched up and driven to the off side for a single
slower one, goes down the track and wants to hit over long-on, beaten for pace, inside edge to the keeper
short from Harshal, goes for a cut, gets a lot of wrist on it, goes through point for a single
on the off stump, worked away by Smith to the leg side for a single
goes down the pitch, wanted to hit it over extra-cover, Zaheer came in quickly and holds on to it in the end at short cover

goes down the track, wanted to hit it over mid-wicket, hits his pad, but still kept going for the run, de Villiers comes in front quickly and has a shy at the striker's end, had that hit, it was bye-bye captain
inside out again, this time over extra-cover for four, excellent shot from the newly anointed captain
goes down the pitch, inside-out, through the covers but straight to the deep fielder for a single
pitched up, outside the off stump, played away to deep square-leg for a single
on the middle stump, he was going down the track, flicked it away to long-leg for a single
outside the off stump, punched to the off side for a single
slower one, waits for it and opens the face of the bat and gathers a single
slower one, deviating into the bat, misses reading the pace and hits the back pad, there was an appeal but the umpire must have thought it was going above the stumps
short of length, outside the off stump, scooped over the mid-on region but just falls short of long-on
outside the off stump and he goes for a cut, it was short of length too but he misses
on the middle stump and that has been hoicked over short fine-leg for a four!
on the off stump, short of length, punched back to the bowler
outside the off stump, punched to the off side for a single
pitched up, swept away to long-leg for a single
pitched up yet again and driven to short mid-wicket
quicker, on the middle, almost through him, gets the bat down in time
on the pads, turning a little, tapped away to long-leg for a couple of quick runs
down the track and stumped! It was bowled flatter, quicker and he misses, de Villiers makes a much better fist of collecting this one and removes the bails easily!
goes down the pitch and chips it in the air, goes to long-on for a single
shorter one, wanted to smack it away but hurries on to him and to short mid-wicket
from round the stumps, on his pads, probably a straighter one as well, worked away to fine-leg for a single
quicker yet again, shorter too, pushed back to the bowler
outside the off stump, Mathews brings his bat out and pushes it to the off side for a single
shorter, quicker, flicked away to the backward square-leg for a single
pitched up, and he works it from outside the off stump to the leg side for a single
wanted to paddle sweep, outside the off stump, misses and it hits the pads, appeal but it was hitting outside the off
uses his feet, down the track and gives himself room, drives through extra-cover for a four, what a shot!
down the leg side, attempts a sweep, misses and de Villiers manages to stop it from going to the boundary
on the middle, Mathews was able to nudge it away to the leg side, to fine-leg
on the stumps, driven back to the bowler
outside the off stump, short of length, driven to short cover
pitched right up to the bat, flicked it to short mid-wicket, where Kohli makes an absolute meal of it, single to the batsman
outside the off stump, pushed to the covers
on the middle stump, bit of a turn away from the bat, pushes to the off side

down the track, stumped! He was trying to go down the pitch to smack him over long-on, that was a quicker, straighter one and he missed it completely and de Villiers just about manages to hold on to the ball and flick the bails off
shorter from Murali, goes back and drives to short mid-wicket where Kohli misfields to allow a single
on the off stump, bit of spin into him, defended back to the bowler
pitched up, outside the off-stump, tries to drive, gets an outside edge to third-man for a single
full-toss, was attempting the yorker but it misses the length, Uthappa drives it back to long-on for a single
outside the off stump, short of length, cut away through point for a couple of runs
thwack, six! That was has been deposited into the stands, pitched right up to the bat and he swung hard at it, was a slower one from the back of the hand
short ball from the bowler and Uthappa has smacked him over mid-wicket for a four, they are batting well here, this pair
pitched up, on the middle stump, driven to long-on for a single
pitches it on the good length, Uthappa goes for the conventional sweep but misses and it hits his pads
nudged away to the leg side for a single
some flight from Murali, Uthappa was trying to sweep but misses too much of a bat, and it goes to short fine-leg
quicker again but this time Uthappa has reverse swept it away for four! was on the middle stump and Uthappa does well to get some bat there
comes down the track, saw him coming, sent it quicker, Uthappa wanted to defend and he slips in the middle of the track!
quicker one, shorter too, on the back foot punched to the off side
up and over, this man can hit them! He gives himself some room and hits it over the extra-cover region, the field like before, was up in the circle and he gets a four
floats it up, and the batsman comes down the track, mistimes it, driven to wide mid-on for a couple of runs
gives himself room and drives it through the covers for four, the fielders were up on the off side and he pierces that field well
tossed up again, driven to long-off for a single
full-pitched, outside the off stump, wanted to drive it, misses the bat and the off stump
down the leg side, tries to work it away to the leg side, hits his pads and they are away for a single
four more, tries to heave it over mid-wicket, gets a top edge and goes over the slip for a four, beating the third-man fielder
length ball and Uthappa flat bats it past a diving Zaheer at mid-on, the long-off fielder ran to long-on and does well to slide and save it
outside the off stump and cut away for four! The third-man was up in the circle and he beats the fielders in the circle easily
takes a step forward, it was a length ball and he was still able to push it to mid-on for a quick single
opens the face of the bat, drives through point and they are back for a couple of runs, third-man runs across to tidy up. Short run called by the umpire though.
on the off stump, punched to the covers but to the fielder
length ball, on the off stump, opens the face of the bat and easily goes through to the third-man for four, the fielder was up in the circle there
gone, caught at long-on! This was not pitched, length ball, he tried to go over long-on, but there was a fielder who takes a simple catch just in front of the fence.
slower one, outside the off stump, but fuller, driven to long-off who is now back to the boundary and they are off for a single
slower ball, was shaping to pull that one because it was short too, misses playing the shot too aggressively, gets a single to square-leg
pitched up yet again, outside the off stump and he drives it in the air, over extra cover for four. Again, it did not look beautiful but was effective
pitched up to the bat, Clarke wants to go over the bowler but gets bit of a bottom of the bat, goes high in the air but just beats mid-on for a couple
pitched up yet again and driven down the ground, to mid-off but to the fielder
gives himself some room, drives to the covers, gets no timing because of the slowness of the pitch and they are able to go through for a single
on off stump, angling into the batsman, he drives it back to the left of Zaheer, who fields well
pitched up and driven over the mid-off fielder, it was in the air and off an edge but almost goes through to the fence.
outside the off stump, pitched up, width afford and Uthappa wanted to go after it, he misses the edge!
round the wicket again, pitches on middle, deviates away from the bat, gets the outside half of the bat to covers
outside the off stump, short of length again, pushed to the covers but to the hands
outside the off stump, short of length, punched it back to mid-off to the fielder
pitched up, within the stumps and punched back to the bowler, beats mid-on and he is away!
outside the off stump, driven to covers and they are off! Clarke underestimated the fielder at covers and he was miles out of his crease when the throw came in. Missed!
short ball, Uthappa ducks into the delivery and lets it go through to the keeper. Uthappa was batting outside the crease
pitched up, inside edge on to the pads, flicked to the leg side for a single
bowled him! Stumps scattered on the ground! That was pitching on the off-stump and from round the wicket, he gets the ball to deviate away and hits the off stump.
again from round the stumps, deviating away from the bat, misses the outside edge of the bat
deviating in, hits the pads and caught in front of the stumps! He was bowling round the stumps, got the ball to angle in, hits the pads and that seems good enough, lbw for four!
down the track and smacked through wide mid-off for four! One came in, the second went away, beating the bat, this time he throws caution to the winds and smashes!
and this one goes away from the bat, misses the outside edge and beaten
pitched up, on the middle and swinging in to the bat, hits the pads and deflects to the leg side
